messages.subject: Re: [knitr] knitr to pdf src image issue
parts:
<img> is an HTML tag, and it is not portable in the sense that Pandoc
won't convert it to LaTeX. Only the Markdown syntax is portable, i.e.
![]() but you cannot set the alignment or size of the image when using
the Markdown syntax.

If the image is generated from an R plot, you can use chunk options
fig.align, fig.with/fig.height, out.width/out.height to set the
alignment/size, and knitr will automatically generate LaTeX or HTML
code according to the output format. That is a portable approach.
